html:
G'oya

Ikki oy uchun ikki alohida hisob: jan CTE'si har bir mijozning yanvardagi jami xaridini, feb esa fevraldagisini beradi. Keyin ularni customer_id bo'yicha oddiy JOIN bilan ulaymiz. JOIN ning o'zi "ikkala oyda ham buyurtma bor" shartini bajaradi: bir oyda xarid qilmagan mijoz juft topolmaydi.

Yechim

WITH jan AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-02-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
feb AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2024-02-01' AND order_date < '2024-03-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT j.customer_id, j.total AS jan_total, f.total AS feb_total
FROM jan j
JOIN feb f ON f.customer_id = j.customer_id
WHERE f.total > j.total

Oraliqning oxiri ochiq: < '2024-03-01'. Bunday yozilganda fevralda necha kun borligini o'ylash shart emas. Namunada faqat 1-mijoz qoladi: yanvarda 300, fevralda 350. 2-mijozning fevrali kamroq, 3-mijoz esa yanvarda umuman xarid qilmagan.

Tuzoqlar

Fevral oxirini 28-sana deb olish. 2024-yil kabisa, 29-fevral ham bor va u kungi buyurtmalar hisobdan tushib qoladi:

Noto'g'riWITH jan AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
feb AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-28'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT j.customer_id, j.total AS jan_total, f.total AS feb_total
FROM jan j
JOIN feb f ON f.customer_id = j.customer_id
WHERE f.total > j.total

Faqat oyni tekshirish (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 1, SQLite'da strftime('%m', order_date) = '01') 2023-yil yanvarini ham qo'shib yuboradi.

LEFT JOIN va COALESCE(j.total, 0) ham xato: yanvarda xarid qilmagan mijozning yanvari 0 bo'lib qoladi va har qanday fevral undan katta. Fevral yanvarga teng bo'lsa, bu "ko'p" emas, shuning uchun >.

Boshqa yo'l

Jadvalni bir marta o'qib, shartli yig'indi bilan ham bo'ladi. CASE da ELSE yo'q, shuning uchun yanvarda buyurtmasi yo'q mijozda jan_total NULL chiqadi, NULL bilan solishtirish esa hech qachon rost emas:

WITH t AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date < '2024-02-01' THEN amount END) AS jan_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2024-02-01' THEN amount END) AS feb_total
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-03-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, jan_total, feb_total
FROM t
WHERE feb_total > jan_total
